$comment: Listen player: words the speech engines mispronounce, as term -> plain-English respelling read by both engines (Kokoro and the browser voice). Whole word, case-sensitive. Acronyms live in src/scripts/tts/normalize.ts (SPELL, SAY). A post overrides with `pronounce:` front matter or inline :say[term]{as="..."}. Evidence per entry: `kokoro` = Kokoro G2P phonemes for the respelling, `was` = phonemes for the written word, `heard` = what a speech recogniser (Parakeet TDT) transcribed from Kokoro's audio, written word -> respelling.
